propositions: Add caused_by as a seventh link relation type to express bug causality as a first-class graph edge, following discovered_from precedent (directional, non-blocking, non-cycle-inducing, Jira-unmapped).
The hardcoded non-blocking tuple in _graph.py line ~204 must include caused_by or the relation will incorrectly receive blocking-cycle semantics.
caused_by must be added to the relation enum in common.schema.json, CANONICAL_RELATIONS, and unlink.py _USAGE string to maintain consistency across schema, types, links, and CLI surfaces.
Golden CLI-help snapshots in tests/golden/cli_help/ must be regenerated to enumerate caused_by in help text (link.txt, overview.txt, and ~8 related .out files).
Backward compatibility: old LINK events without caused_by and all six legacy relations must continue reducing without error; the change is purely additive with no persisted data rewrite.
